headline: Split a holiday dinner bill in seconds
lede: Enter the total, the group size, tax and tip.

pin.title: Group Bill Split Calculator: Split Dinner With Tax and Tip
pin.description: Holiday dinners and group outings get messy once tax and tip land on the bill. Add them before you split: a $360 bill for 8 people with 8.25% tax and an 18% tip comes to $454.50, or $56.81 each. The free calculator does the math for any group.
pin.alt: Group bill split calculator showing a $360 bill, 8 people, 8.25% sales tax and an 18% tip, so each person pays $56.81.
